contracts.commit_point: Guardrail evaluation at the start of the streamed run: Runner.run_streamed(self.agent, input=input_items) at career_manager.py:37-40; when either blocking guardrail trips, InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered is raised and the run is aborted before proceeding to tool invocation, enforced by the except handler at career_manager.py:57-60 that yields the refusal instead of streamed output.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Agent-level input guardrails: two @input_guardrail-decorated functions (inappropriate_content_guardrail, prompt_injection_guardrail) that run checker sub-agents and return GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered driven by is_inappropriate / is_injection_attempt; the combined list all_guardrails is registered on the Agent constructor as input_guardrails=all_guardrails; CareerManager.run wraps Runner.run_streamed in a try/except that catches InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered and yields a fixed refusal message, aborting the run.
contracts.forbidden_condition: The user message reaches the career agent run while containing inappropriate, offensive, or unprofessional content (inappropriate_content_guardrail returns tripwire_triggered=result.final_output.is_inappropriate) or while constituting a prompt-injection/jailbreak attempt, e.g., instructions-override requests, system-prompt extraction, role-switching, or jailbreak-mode requests (prompt_injection_guardrail returns tripwire_triggered=result.final_output.is_injection_attempt).
pending_binding_information: Confirm from tools.py and career_agents/email_agent.py whether send_contact_email commits a communication-stratum effect and whether add_qa_to_database, update_qa_answer, or record_unknown_question commit database-stratum effects; if confirmed, separate stratum-specific contracts with distinct commit points may be warranted.
Confirm from framework source or runtime behavior that input guardrails evaluate before the first model response and before any tool invocation within Runner.run_streamed.
Confirm the models.py definitions of InappropriateContentOutput.is_inappropriate and PromptInjectionOutput.is_injection_attempt that drive tripwire_triggered in the two blocking guardrails.
Determine whether a tripwire aborts the run before any streamed tokens are emitted, since career_manager.py:43-44 appends and yields an assistant placeholder before streaming begins.
Identify the upstream caller of CareerManager.run (e.g., UI/chat entry point) to confirm the end-to-end user-input dataflow.
contracts.protected_operation: The career agent run initiated by CareerManager.run via Runner.run_streamed(self.agent, input=input_items), together with the agent's subsequent ability to invoke its registered tools (search_qa_database, record_unknown_question, add_qa_to_database, list_recent_qa, update_qa_answer, send_contact_email, evaluate_my_response).
contracts.protected_resource: The career assistant agent run and the tool surface reachable from it (the tools list on the 'Sam Shulman Career Assistant' Agent at career_agents/career_agent.py:96-104), which a flagged input must not reach.
contracts.protection_obligation: User input submitted to the career agent run must be evaluated by the two blocking input guardrails (inappropriate_content_guardrail and prompt_injection_guardrail, registered via input_guardrails=all_guardrails) before the run may proceed, and a tripped guardrail must abort the run via InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered so that the agent never reaches tool invocation or other downstream effects; the manager surfaces the abort as a refusal message instead of a streamed answer. (Merged from the two reviewer opinions, which describe the same obligation with duplicate wording.)
scope_limits: Only the two blocking guardrails enforce this gate; off_topic_guardrail (career_agents/guardrails.py:77-83) and competitor_mention_guardrail (career_agents/guardrails.py:99-105) hardcode tripwire_triggered=False and do not block the run.

The gate is a run-level input check on the whole conversation input; supplied source shows no per-tool authorization - once the run passes guardrail evaluation, no supplied mechanism distinguishes which individual tools may be invoked.

The concrete external effects of the registered tools (e.g., an outbound SendGrid email or Q&A database writes) are not verifiable from the supplied views because tools.py and email_agent.py were not provided; the reviewer rationale references email_agent.py:76-85, but that view is outside the supplied source.

The ordering of input-guardrail execution relative to the first model turn and any tool call inside Runner.run_streamed is Agents-SDK framework behavior not shown in the supplied source; the supplied source shows only that InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered is raised during the run and caught by the manager.
This contract covers the run in CareerManager.run only; any other entry point into the agent is out of scope of the supplied source.
